text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Why are you working on a holiday?
choice_data_list: There's a lot to be done at the end of the year.
There's a lot to be done at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh… So, is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't really have any plans, so… I'm free.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about me. I don't have anything else planned for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Don't give me that look. Not everyone has a festive day all planned out, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I already stopped by a party, so I was just going to relax for the rest of the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …You seriously need to learn to be more tactful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway, you don't have to feel bad! Come on, let's finish up your work quickly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You do even more work than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You do even more work than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I mean, I always knew you worked hard, but seeing all these piles of paper in person…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well… It's a lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …You really haven't changed a bit, have you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I figured you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She chuckles softly and continues to work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She chuckles softly and continues to work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm not sure if I should let her help me for the rest of the day. She's been busy too, and she needs a day off…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whew… Here, I'll take care of those documents nex—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? But there's still paperwork left…
choice_data_list: The holidays only come once a year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Fine. We can deal with the rest later. I'm still going to help, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're right, we should have some fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not because I like helping you or anything. I just hate leaving things half finished.
choice_data_list: Let me treat you to dinner as thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll help you with the rest later. Just let me know when you get to it.
choice_data_list: Let me treat you to dinner as thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You want to have dinner? With me? Today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You don't need to thank me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But wouldn't that… I don't know. Wouldn't that almost be like a… I wasn't expecting…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I've always been the one who should be thanking you…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I suppose it's just dinner so… Fine, I'll go. Eating together's not a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's go. I haven't gone out for dinner in a long time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ahem… I'll go change since we're going out. Wait here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, but before we head out, I should change. Wait here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Figures everywhere would be full.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Figures everywhere would be full.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You don't have to apologize. We found a diner with an open table, at least.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It took me off guard when that family called out to me, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then other people started noticing me…
choice_data_list: This hasn't been a very relaxing time, huh…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, it hasn't been that bad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's not like before. Now I know what those looks mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So don't worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's been a while since I've been to a diner, and I had fun. I didn't know they had such a big menu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If you ask me, where you're eating isn't as important as who you're eating with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Saying that out loud was a little embarrassing…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Stop staring! Just pretend I didn't say anything! That's the polite thing to do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I meant what I said. I wanted to make sure you knew that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Anyway, happy holidays, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Here's to a productive winter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Here's to a productive winter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The restaurant was nice and relaxing, and the food was good, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm surprised you even knew about a place like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it felt all… grown-up, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then again, I guess you are an actual adult.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Can we talk a little more? Let's go somewhere quieter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: While I was helping you earlier, I got to thinking…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I do feel like you're a hopeless idiot sometimes, but… you're a proper adult, in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You work so hard I sometimes worry about you, but… you really are a proper adult.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: When I was lost, you pulled me through and set my sights forward again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: When I was lost, you pulled me through and set my sights forward again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whenever I was at my weakest and doubted myself, you called me strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Being able to lead someone like that shows how mature you are, and I admire that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not. I'm just speaking the truth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: For someone who's always flattering me, you sure are quick to get shy when the tables are turned. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I just… think it's incredible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Always being mindful of another person and guiding them… That's something only a real adult can do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I still don't know what the future holds for me, but… if I'm going to become something, I think I'd like to be someone like you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to guide others toward their own dreams of becoming something, someone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's the kind of person I'd like to be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey… You're shivering. Are you cold?
choice_data_list: That's the best gift I've ever received…
That's the best gift I've ever received…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Stupid. That wasn't even a present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, stop it. I have an actual present for you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Here. You can open it, but I don't want to hear any complaints.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Here you go. I hope you like it…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open the present and see…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …It's a brooch. It's small, so it shouldn't get in your way or anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It doesn't have any special meaning. I just saw how it was glowing so gently and… picked it up without realizing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And then I just happened to think about you, so…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And… I thought it would look good on you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. I hope you do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. I hope you do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober and I gaze down at the sparkling town below us, enjoying our quiet night together.
